title: 第25章 晋升万法境第26章 击杀天剑宗长老
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
小塔第一层。
这里一片混沌，广袤无边，只有一棵扶桑树耸立在无尽混沌气中，高不知多少里，堪比一颗巨大的星辰。
李易盘坐在扶桑树的枝干上，啃了几枚烈阳果，服下几颗圣丹，身旁摆放好一堆灵石，开始静心修行阴阳混沌经。
这门无上功法是三大女帝传授给他的，说是最为适合纯阳之体修炼，不过却是残缺不全，只有前面十二重。
目前李易只修行到第三重，已经突破到元府境中期。
他想用这一百多天的时间冲击第四重，晋升万法境，到时就能掌控天地元气，形成万法异象，达到御器飞行的地步，就可以不用御剑术飞行了。
在修炼方面。
李易的天赋和悟性极高，很快就进入了深层次的闭关中。
扶桑树顶端，天璇女帝盘膝而坐，浑圆修长的大腿上放着一把精致的长剑，美眸微闭，也在修炼。
时光荏苒，转眼两个月过去了。
李易一直处于闭关中，没有移动分毫。
“轰。”
就在此时，他通体突然闪耀璀璨的七彩光芒，爆发出一股恐怖的波动，周边的混沌气动荡起来，随着他的呼吸而起伏，附近的扶桑树的枝干与树叶也在摇颤。
他就像一个太阳，灿烂夺目，天地万物因他的呼吸而震动。
“这是……少阳初成！”
天璇女帝睁开美眸，盯着神光笼罩的李易，眼里露出惊讶之色。
纯阳之体一共分为九个进化阶段，别是少阳，中阳，老阳，太阳，圣阳，道阳，帝阳，仙阳，神阳。
进化程度越高，所展现出来的元阳与纯阳之气就越浓郁，越强大。
李易这三年的元阳之气一直处于亏空状态，还能在这么短时间进化成少阳，由此可见，他的纯阳之体有多纯正，多阳刚！
也不知过了多久。

李易身躯不再喷薄七彩光华，慢慢内敛体内。
“哧。”
李易猛地睁开了双眼，两道目光直射而出，犹如缭绕火焰的剑气一般，将百丈之内的混沌气给劈出了两道巨大的轨迹。
“成功了，我重修到了万法境。”
李易欣喜若狂，长身而起。
这一刻，他感受到体内磅礴的真气在涌动，丹田处开辟的元府浩瀚如湖泊，里面的真气浓郁，浩浩荡荡，源源不绝。
他感受到自己与天地元气再次有了沟通。
这一次能如此快晋升到万法境，原因有三。
一是他一个多月前就已经达到万法境，只是因为与玉衡女帝双修，被吸干了元阳和精血，导致修为暴跌。
二是他吃了极品圣丹，上品宝药烈阳果，还用了大量灵石，资源足够。
三是他的天资妖孽，悟性超绝，不管是领悟阴阳混沌经的精髓，还是修行速度，都远超普通修士。
多措并举之下，修行这么快，也是可以理解的。
“这点修为也高兴得起来，在上界，你这年纪才这点修为，完全是不入流，别说与那些顶级天骄相比，就连一条狗，一只猫狗比不过。”
天璇女帝绝美的脸上写满了轻蔑。
李易的满腔热血被泼了一盆冷水，笑容一下消失了，握着拳，认真道：“我会追上他们的。”
接着。
李易又开始修行起来，趁着还有一个多月，他想将万剑归宗剩下的七千变化多学一点。
天剑在他的意念控制下，幻化成无数柄剑，以各个角度冲天而去，绚丽而璀璨。
万剑归宗的奥义与剑诀一点点被他理解消化，成为自己的剑道理论。
不久后。

李易便完全沉浸于剑道的学习与运用中，时而御剑飞行，直冲云霄；时而剑化万千，如流星般倾泻而下；时而剑若万钧，凌空斩落。
他浑然忘了时间的流逝，忘记了外界一切。
直到一百零八天的期限到了，传来天璇女帝的声音，才将他从剑道领悟中唤醒。
天璇女帝漠然道：“时间到了，塔内能量不足，你该出去了。”
content_en:
The first floor of the small tower.
There is chaos and vastness here. There is only one hibiscus tree standing in the endless chaos. It is an unknown number of miles high and is comparable to a huge star.
Li Yi sat cross-legged on the branches of the hibiscus tree, nibbled on a few Fierce Yang Fruits, drank a few Holy Pills, placed a pile of spiritual stones beside him, and began to meditate on the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra.
This supreme skill was taught to him by the three empresses. It is said to be the most suitable for pure Yang body cultivation, but it is incomplete, with only the first twelve levels.
At present, Li Yi has only cultivated to the third level and has broken through to the middle stage of Yuanfu realm.
He wants to use these more than a hundred days to attack the fourth level and advance to the realm of Ten Thousand Dharmas. By then, he will be able to control the vitality of heaven and earth, form the vision of Ten Thousand Dharmas, and reach the point where he can fly with a weapon, so that he can fly without the skill of sword control.
In terms of practice.
Li Yi's talent and understanding were extremely high, and he quickly entered a deep retreat.
At the top of the hibiscus tree, Empress Tianxuan sat cross-legged, with an exquisite long sword placed on her round and slender thighs. Her beautiful eyes were slightly closed, and she was also practicing.
Time flies, and two months have passed in the blink of an eye.
Li Yi has been in seclusion and has not moved at all.
"Boom."
At this moment, his whole body suddenly shone with bright seven-colored light, and a terrifying wave erupted. The chaotic energy around him turbulent, rising and falling with his breathing, and the branches and leaves of the nearby fusang tree were also shaking.
He is like a sun, so dazzling that everything in heaven and earth vibrates with his breath.
"This is... Shaoyang's first achievement!"
Empress Tianxuan opened her beautiful eyes and stared at Li Yi, who was shrouded in divine light, with a look of surprise in her eyes.
The body of Pure Yang is divided into nine evolutionary stages, namely Shaoyang, Zhongyang, Laoyang, Taiyang, Shengyang, Daoyang, Emperor Yang, Xianyang, and Shenyang.
The higher the degree of evolution, the richer and more powerful the Yuan Yang and Pure Yang Qi displayed.
Li Yi's Yuanyang Qi has been in a state of deficit for the past three years, and he can evolve into Shaoyang in such a short period of time. This shows how pure and masculine his pure Yang body is!
I don’t know how much time passed.
Li Yi's body no longer sprayed out the colorful brilliance, and slowly restrained himself.
"Chi."
Li Yi suddenly opened his eyes, and his two gazes shot straight out, like sword energy swirling in flames, splitting the chaos energy within a hundred feet into two huge trajectories.
"Successful, I have reached the realm of ten thousand dharma again."
Li Yi was so happy that he stood up.
At this moment, he felt the majestic zhenqi surging in his body. The Yuan Mansion opened up in his dantian was as vast as a lake, and the zhenqi inside was rich, vast, and endless.
He felt that he was in communication with the vitality of heaven and earth again.
There are three reasons for being promoted to the Ten Thousand Dharma Realm so quickly this time.
First, he had reached the Ten Thousand Dharma Realm more than a month ago, but because of his dual cultivation with Empress Yuheng, he was drained of Yuanyang and blood essence, causing his cultivation to plummet.
Second, he took the top-grade holy elixir, the top-grade treasure medicine Fiery Yang Fruit, and also used a large number of spiritual stones, so he had sufficient resources.
The third is that he has a demonic talent and extraordinary understanding. Whether he understands the essence of the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra or his cultivation speed, he is far superior to ordinary monks.
With multiple measures taken at the same time, it is understandable that practice is so fast.
"I am happy with this level of cultivation. In the upper world, with your level of cultivation at your age, you are completely inferior. Not to mention compared to those top geniuses, not even a dog, cat or dog can compare with you."
Empress Tianxuan's beautiful face was filled with contempt.
Li Yi's enthusiasm was poured with cold water, and his smile suddenly disappeared. He clenched his fists and said seriously: "I will catch up with them."
Next.
Li Yi started practicing again. While there was still more than a month left, he wanted to learn more about the remaining seven thousand changes of Wanjian Guizong.
Under the control of his thoughts, the Heavenly Sword transformed into countless swords, soaring into the sky from all angles, gorgeous and bright.
The secrets and sword techniques of Wan Jian Guizong were gradually understood and digested by him, and became his own sword.Tao theory.
Soon after.
Li Yi was completely immersed in the study and application of swordsmanship. Sometimes the sword flew straight into the sky;
He completely forgot about the passage of time and everything in the outside world.
It wasn't until the one hundred and eight days expired that Empress Tianxuan's voice came to wake him up from his knowledge of the sword.
Empress Tianxuan said indifferently: "The time is up, there is insufficient energy in the tower, you should go out."
